Description: Balanced privacy profile - reduces diagnostic, advertising and cloud-personalization surfaces without relaxing stricter existing policy
BestFor: Compatibility-focused standalone workstations; managed environments require policy-owner review
Warnings: Settings Sync and AppPrivacy user-choice policies are preserved, not overwritten
Services are not modified by this mode

DisableOneSettingsDownloads.Description: Block dynamic config downloads from Microsoft

DisableSoftLanding.Description: Do not show Windows tips (computer policy)

DisableTailoredExperiencesWithDiagnostic.Description: Do not use diagnostic data for tailored experiences (user policy)

DisableWindowsSpotlightFeatures.Description: Turn off all Windows Spotlight features (user policy)

DisableWindowsSpotlightOnSettings.Description: Turn off Spotlight suggestions in Settings (user policy)

DisableWindowsSpotlightOnActionCenter.Description: Turn off Spotlight notifications in Action Center (user policy)

DisableThirdPartySuggestions.Description: Do not suggest third-party Spotlight content (user policy)

DisableSpotlightCollectionOnDesktop.Description: Turn off Spotlight collection on Desktop (user policy)

Start_IrisRecommendations.Description: User preference: hide Start recommendations (runtime validation required per Windows build)

ShowSyncProviderNotifications.Description: User preference: hide sync-provider notifications in File Explorer (runtime validation required per Windows build)

DisableWebSearch.Description: No web search in Start menu

AllowCortana.Description: Disable Cortana (legacy, Win11 has no Cortana)

BingSearchEnabled.Description: User preference: disable Bing integration in Windows Search (runtime validation required per Windows build)

IsDynamicSearchBoxEnabled.Description: User preference: disable dynamic Search highlights (runtime validation required per Windows build)

IsGlobalWebSearchProviderToggleEnabled.Description: User preference: turn off the current Windows global web-search provider switch (validated through the visible Windows 11 Settings UI)

Microsoft.BingSearch_8wekyb3d8bbwe!App.Description: User preference: turn off the current Microsoft Bing Search app provider (validated through the visible Windows 11 Settings UI)

AllowLinguisticDataCollection.Description: Don't send typing data to Microsoft for language model improvement

UploadUserActivities.Description: Don't upload user activities to cloud

AllowCrossDeviceClipboard.Description: Disable cloud clipboard sync between devices (USER PROMPT in MSRecommended)
